**What problem does this solve?**

Describe the situation you ran into, not just the feature you want.

**Proposed approach**

If you have one in mind. Otherwise, leave it open for discussion.

**Is this in scope?**

This project is deliberately scoped to Gmail bulk-export mechanics —
authentication, checkpointing, rate limiting, CSV/Parquet output. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for what's out of scope
(organization-specific business logic, classification rules, and similar
belong in a downstream project, not here).
